stance: Hike: "several interest rate increases before the spring of 2027"; real policy rate should be "solidly between 2% and 2.5%".

speaker: Lorie Logan
stance: Hike: "at least two more 25-basis-point rate increases"; "may be possible to move more rapidly this winter".

speaker: Michael Barr
stance: Hike: "I expect it will be appropriate to raise rates further."
